## Sharp Edges & Invariants

- **Never silence `NullRenderer` by default.** The `None` mapping raises an exception for unknown node types — this is intentional. If you add a new node type to `DEFAULT_MAPPINGS`, do not remove this safety net.
- **All new renderers must extend `BaseNodeRenderer` or `BaseBlockRenderer`.** Do not duplicate `_find_renderer()` or `_render_content()` dispatch logic — the base classes own this.
- **`embedded-entry-block` default output is a raw `str(entry)`.** This is by design — it produces `<div>{'sys': {...}}</div>` which is a visible placeholder, not a bug. Do not "fix" this without a conscious decision; real applications must override this renderer.
- **No runtime dependencies.** `install_requires` in `setup.py` must stay empty. Do not add runtime dependencies — this is a zero-dep library. Dev/test deps go in `requirements.txt` only.
- **`TextRenderer._find_renderer()` uses `mark["type"]` not `mark["nodeType"]`.** This is a deliberate override of the base class method because marks use a different key. Do not change this.
- **Version is owned by `rich_text_renderer/__init__.py`.** Bump `__version__` there before any release. The `setup.py` reads this via regex — do not hardcode the version elsewhere.
- **`from __future__ import unicode_literals`** appears in all source files. Keep it — removal is cosmetic churn and could affect Python 2 consumers who may still be on older installed versions.

## Key Conventions

- **Commit format:** Free-form (no enforced linting). Convention from history: `type: short description`
- **Branch strategy:** Feature branches merged to `master` via PR
- **Test location:** `tests/` — one file per source module, mirrors `rich_text_renderer/` layout
- **Python version:** 3.7–3.9 tested in CI; 3.7+ required locally
- **No build step:** Pure Python library — no compile, no bundle. `python runtests.py` is the verification loop.

## Integration Points

**Upstream (this repo consumes):**
- Contentful Delivery API (indirectly) — rich text JSON documents come from API responses fetched by [contentful.py](https://github.com/contentful/contentful.py)

**Downstream (consumes this repo):**
- Python applications using Contentful Rich Text fields
- PyPI — published as `rich_text_renderer`

## Build & Quality

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt && python runtests.py && make lint
```
